name: Form
description: High-performance form component with data domain management. Includes data entry, validation, and corresponding styles.

props.name: classes
props.description: Customize class for each semantic structure inside the component. Supports object or function.
props.descriptionZh: 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的 class，支持对象或函数

props.name: styles
props.description: Customize inline style for each semantic structure inside the component. Supports object or function.
props.descriptionZh: 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的行内 style，支持对象或函数

props.name: colon
props.description: Configure the default value of `colon` for Form.Item. Indicates whether the colon after the label is displayed (only effective when prop layout is horizontal)
props.descriptionZh: 配置 Form.Item 的 `colon` 的默认值。表示是否显示 label 后面的冒号 (只有在属性 layout 为 horizontal 时有效)

props.name: name
props.description: Form name. Will be the prefix of Field `id`
props.descriptionZh: 表单名称，会作为表单字段 `id` 前缀使用

props.name: layout
props.description: Form layout
props.descriptionZh: 表单布局

props.name: labelAlign
props.description: The text align of label of all items
props.descriptionZh: label 标签的文本对齐方式

props.name: labelWrap
props.description: whether label can be wrap
props.descriptionZh: label 标签的文本换行方式

props.name: labelCol
props.description: Label layout, like `Col` component. Set `span` `offset` value like `{span: 3, offset: 12}` or `sm: {span: 3, offset: 12}`
props.descriptionZh: label 标签布局，同 `Col` 组件，设置 `span` `offset` 值，如 `{span: 3, offset: 12}` 或 `sm: {span: 3, offset: 12}`

props.name: wrapperCol
props.description: The layout for input controls, same as `labelCol`
props.descriptionZh: 需要为输入控件设置布局样式时，使用该属性，用法同 labelCol

props.name: feedbackIcons
props.description: Can be passed custom icons while `Form.Item` element has `hasFeedback`
props.descriptionZh: 当 `Form.Item` 有 `hasFeedback` 属性时可以自定义图标

props.name: size
props.description: Set field component size (antd components only)
props.descriptionZh: 设置字段组件的尺寸（仅限 antd 组件）

props.name: disabled
props.description: Set form component disable, only available for antd components
props.descriptionZh: 设置表单组件禁用，仅对 antd 组件有效

props.name: scrollToFirstError
props.description: Auto scroll to first failed field when submit
props.descriptionZh: 提交失败自动滚动到第一个错误字段

props.name: requiredMark
props.description: Required mark style. Can use required mark or optional mark. You can not config to single Form.Item since this is a Form level config
props.descriptionZh: 必选样式，可以切换为必选或者可选展示样式。此为 Form 配置，Form.Item 无法单独配置

props.name: variant
props.description: Variant of components inside form
props.descriptionZh: 表单内控件变体

props.name: validateMessages
props.description: Validation prompt template, description [see below](#validatemessages)
props.descriptionZh: 验证提示模板，说明[见下](#validatemessages)

props.name: model
props.description: Form model
props.descriptionZh: 表单数据

props.name: rules
props.description: Form rules
props.descriptionZh: 表单规则

props.name: validateTrigger
props.description: Config field validate trigger. When set to `false`, all interaction-driven validation is disabled even if a rule declares `trigger` or `validateTrigger`; `validateFields` and submit validation still run
props.descriptionZh: 统一设置字段触发验证的时机。设为 `false` 时禁用所有交互事件触发的校验，即使规则单独声明了 `trigger` 或 `validateTrigger`；`validateFields` 和提交校验仍会执行

props.name: preserve
props.description: Keep field value even when field removed. You can get the preserve field value by `getFieldsValue(true)`
props.descriptionZh: 当字段被删除时保留字段值。你可以通过 `getFieldsValue(true)` 来获取保留字段值

props.name: clearOnDestroy
props.description: Clear form values when the form is uninstalled
props.descriptionZh: 当表单被卸载时清空表单值

props.name: validateOnRuleChange
props.description: Automatically revalidates the form when `Form.rules` changes
props.descriptionZh: 当 `Form.rules` 发生变化时，自动重新触发表单校验

props.name: rootClass
props.description: Root container class
props.descriptionZh: 根容器类名

props.name: prefixCls
props.description: Prefix class name
props.descriptionZh: 组件前缀类名

events.name: finish
events.description: Trigger after submitting the form and verifying data successfully
events.descriptionZh: 提交表单且数据验证成功后回调事件

events.name: finishFailed
events.description: Trigger after submitting the form and verifying data failed
events.descriptionZh: 提交表单且数据验证失败后回调事件

events.name: submit
events.description: Triggered on native form submit before internal validation starts
events.descriptionZh: 原生表单提交时触发，在内部校验开始前执行

events.name: validate
events.type: (name: InternalNamePath, status: boolean, errors: any[] \| null) => void
events.description: Triggered when a single field finishes validation. Returns the field path, pass status, and error messages
events.descriptionZh: 单个字段校验完成时触发，返回字段路径、是否通过以及错误信息

events.name: valuesChange
events.type: (changedValues: Record<string, any>, values: Record<string, any>) => void
events.descriptionZh: 字段值更新时触发回调事件

events.name: fieldsChange
events.descriptionZh: 字段更新时触发回调事件

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Get the value of a single field
methods.descriptionZh: 获取单个字段值

methods.name: getFieldsValue
methods.description: Get values of a group of fields. Pass `true` to return values of all currently collected fields
methods.descriptionZh: 获取一组字段值；传 `true` 时返回当前已收集字段的值

methods.name: getFieldError
methods.description: Get error messages of a single field
methods.descriptionZh: 获取单个字段的错误信息

methods.name: getFieldsError
methods.description: Get field error info list, including `errors` and `warnings`
methods.descriptionZh: 获取字段错误信息列表，包含 `errors` 和 `warnings`

methods.name: getFieldWarning
methods.description: Get warning messages of a single field
methods.descriptionZh: 获取单个字段的警告信息

methods.name: isFieldsTouched
methods.description: Check whether fields have been operated on. When `allFieldsTouched` is `true`, all fields must be touched
methods.descriptionZh: 检查字段是否已被操作；当 `allFieldsTouched` 为 `true` 时要求全部字段都已被操作

methods.name: isFieldTouched
methods.description: Check whether a single field has been operated on
methods.descriptionZh: 检查单个字段是否已被操作

methods.name: isFieldsValidating
methods.description: Check whether fields are validating
methods.descriptionZh: 检查字段是否处于校验中

methods.name: isFieldValidating
methods.description: Check whether a single field is validating
methods.descriptionZh: 检查单个字段是否处于校验中

methods.name: resetFields
methods.description: Reset field values, status, and validation results. Resets all fields when omitted
methods.descriptionZh: 重置字段值、状态和校验结果；不传时重置全部字段

methods.name: clearValidate
methods.description: Clear validation results without changing field values
methods.descriptionZh: 清空字段校验结果，不修改字段值

methods.name: setFields
methods.description: Set field state and values directly. Useful for writing `errors`, `warnings`, `touched`, and similar meta manually
methods.descriptionZh: 直接设置字段状态和字段值，可手动写入 `errors`、`warnings`、`touched` 等

methods.name: setFieldValue
methods.description: Set the value of a single field
methods.descriptionZh: 设置单个字段值

methods.name: setFieldsValue
methods.description: Set values of multiple fields in batch
methods.descriptionZh: 批量设置多个字段值

methods.name: validateFields
methods.description: Validate fields and return the corresponding field values
methods.descriptionZh: 触发字段校验并返回对应字段值

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Alias of `validateFields()` for validating the whole form
methods.descriptionZh: `validateFields()` 的别名，用于校验整个表单

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submit the form. Equivalent to triggering form `submit`
methods.descriptionZh: 提交表单，效果等同于触发表单 `submit`

methods.name: nativeElement
methods.description: Root `form` element
methods.descriptionZh: 表单根 `form` 元素

methods.name: scrollToField
methods.description: Scroll to the specified field. By default it will also try to focus the field
methods.descriptionZh: 滚动到指定字段位置，默认会尝试聚焦该字段

methods.name: focusField
methods.description: Focus the DOM element of the specified field
methods.descriptionZh: 聚焦指定字段对应的 DOM 元素

methods.name: getFieldInstance
methods.description: Get the registered field instance
methods.descriptionZh: 获取已注册字段实例

properties.name: labelAlign
properties.descriptionZh: label 标签的文本对齐方式

properties.name: labelCol
properties.description: The layout of label. If both Form and Form.Item exists, use Item first
properties.descriptionZh: label 标签布局，同 `Col` 组件

properties.name: wrapperCol
properties.description: The layout for input controls, same as `labelCol`
properties.descriptionZh: 需要为输入控件设置布局样式时，使用该属性，用法同 labelCol

properties.name: colon
properties.description: Used with `label`, whether to display `:` after label text
properties.descriptionZh: 配合 `label` 使用，是否显示 `:`

properties.name: help
properties.description: The prompt message. If not provided, the prompt message will be generated by the validation rule
properties.descriptionZh: 提示信息，不配置则按校验规则生成

properties.name: hasFeedback
properties.descriptionZh: 配合 `validateStatus` 展示状态图标

properties.name: required
properties.description: Display required style. When not set, it will be generated by the validation rule. Set it to `false` to disable the style.
properties.descriptionZh: 必填样式设置。如不设置，则会根据校验规则自动生成。设置为 `false` 可禁用该样式

properties.name: validateTrigger
properties.description: When to validate the value of children node. When set to `false`, all interaction-driven validation for the field is disabled even if a rule declares `trigger` or `validateTrigger`; explicit `validateFields` and submit validation still run
properties.descriptionZh: 触发校验的时机。设为 `false` 时禁用当前字段的所有交互事件校验，即使规则单独声明了 `trigger` 或 `validateTrigger`；显式调用 `validateFields` 或提交时仍会校验

properties.name: validateFirst
properties.description: Whether stop validate on first rule of error for this field. Will parallel validate when `parallel` configured
properties.descriptionZh: 是否在第一个规则失败后停止

properties.name: noStyle
properties.description: No style for `true`, used as a pure field control
properties.descriptionZh: 为 `true` 时不带样式，仅作为字段控制

properties.name: hidden
properties.description: Whether to hide Form.Item (still collect and validate value)
properties.descriptionZh: 是否隐藏 Form.Item（依然收集与校验）

slots.name: label
slots.description: Custom label content (higher priority than `label` prop)
slots.descriptionZh: 自定义标签内容（优先于 `label` 属性）

slots.name: tooltip
slots.description: Custom label tooltip content. The slot arg is the current `tooltip` config; when `tooltip` is an options object, returning an object from slot will be merged into it
slots.descriptionZh: 自定义标签提示内容。插槽参数为当前 `tooltip` 配置；当 `tooltip` 为对象配置时，插槽返回对象会与原配置合并

slots.name: extra
slots.description: Custom extra message (higher priority than `extra` prop)
slots.descriptionZh: 自定义额外提示信息（优先于 `extra` 属性）

slots.name: help
slots.description: Custom help/error message (higher priority than `help` prop)
slots.descriptionZh: 自定义帮助/错误提示（优先于 `help` 属性）

commonProps.name: rootClass
commonProps.descriptionZh: 添加在组件最外层的 className

commonProps.name: autoFocus
commonProps.description: Auto focus when component mounted, only effective for focusable elements like forms, links, etc.
commonProps.descriptionZh: 自动获取焦点，仅对表单类、链接、交互容器等可聚焦元素生效
